entries.name: box-index-2-32-accept#0
entries.description: A bare box (value 1000000, SigmaProp(true), height 1, no tokens) whose index is written as 2^32 (80 80 80 80 10). The index is a getUShort (ErgoBox.scala:218), which scorex-util reads as getULong().toInt and only then checks 0..65535: 2^32 reads as 0. The box parses and keeps the bytes as received for its id (:222); the round-trip re-serializes it with the index 00. NON-IDENTITY. An impl that range-checks the full value rejects it: the over-reject.

entries.name: box-index-2-32-plus-1-accept#1
entries.description: A bare box (value 1000000, SigmaProp(true), height 1, no tokens) whose index is written as 2^32 + 1 (8180808010): it reads as 1 and is written back as 01. NON-IDENTITY.

entries.name: box-index-wraps-to-65536-reject#2
entries.description: A bare box (value 1000000, SigmaProp(true), height 1, no tokens) whose index is written as 2^32 + 2^16 (8080848010): truncated to 32 bits it is 65536, outside the unsigned short range: the JVM rejects. An impl that keeps the low 16 bits reads 0 and accepts: the over-accept.

entries.name: box-r4-coll-length-wraps-accept#3
entries.description: A bare box (value 1000000, SigmaProp(true), height 1, no tokens) whose R4 is a Coll[Byte] with its length written as 2^32 + 1 (8180808010), then the byte ab. A collection's length in data is a getUShort too (CoreDataSerializer.scala:132): it reads as 1, and the register is written back as 0e 01 ab. NON-IDENTITY.
